title: Yield test: patina_grazer at gossamer_null (lawless); what a kill drops and whether a bid takes it
note: A test with one ship (orders.log ENT-011, block APOPHIS: every untested herd of prey of 100 hull or less with ten animals or more gets a test hunt; F9). No run of ours has looted this species. The herd read 12 at 2026-11-16 01:52 UTC, 60 hull (data/wildlife/). Beyond policed space (F13): `alone` and an empty hold. 2 kills a run, ranched: no hunt below 4 animals. Loot that no bid of 50 cr or more takes is stored at the station, so the row's goods show the drop; whether it is caustic sac (bid 420 cr at seven stations) is part of the question. Written by Apophis 2026-11-16 03:00 UTC; it leaves the plan after its first RESULT line unless the drop sells. The patina-grazer test in our space (hunt-test-acubens-patina-grazer) never fought: a foreign ship stood at the place in its runs.
